sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Native "Barcode" columns now get a GS1 mod-10 format/check-digit validity pass — `initBarcodeValidation()`, page-agnostic, self-detecting via the native `td.barcode-cell` class. A barcode that doesn't match a known length (EAN-8/UPC-A/EAN-13/GTIN-14) or whose check digit doesn't match renders with a ⚠️ warning glyph and an explanatory tooltip. It NEVER rewrites the displayed value, for either valid or invalid entries — unlike ISRC's own reformatting of valid codes.

The 📊 unique-values dropdown for a "Barcode" column now offers three new sections: "Barcode - Validity" (✅/⚠️ valid/invalid counts, mutually exclusive per row since a Barcode cell holds 0 or 1 value), "Barcode - Format" (which GS1 format — UPC-A/EAN-13/EAN-8/GTIN-14 — a STRICTLY CONFORMING entry matches), and "Barcode - Same As" (rows whose barcode NUMBER matches another row's even in a different textual representation, e.g. a UPC-A and its own zero-padded EAN-13 form — deliberately independent of the release's own Format column, unlike the existing `sa_enable_barcode_highlight` merge-checkbox feature's grouping) — `_parseBarcodeCode()`/`_findCellBarcodeParts()`/`_getBarcodeCanonicalCounts()`.
New `sa_enable_barcode_validation` setting (default on) gates the whole feature in one place.
